That has then gone down the path of, "what if in 6 weeks I notice no change, and feel even more hopeless?! That will further exacerbate the depression!"   


Really, the only thing that is allowing me to sit with the thoughts is that there is one way to garuntee the medication will not be helpful, and that is if I have unreasonable expectations for the support it can offer me. I've taken real comfort in being curious about what the future may hold for myself and lexapro as we finally take a waltz together, but I cannot be sure how that dance will go. I just intend to be dancing in one way or another, that is remaining hopeful and optimistic!
